response.overview: "The Return of the Lawyer" follows LLE Badman upon his release from prison after serving five years for forging his law license. Facing a harsh reality filled with obstacles and struggles, he attempts to pick up the pieces and start anew. As he copes with the fallout of his past and the challenges of life after incarceration, will he succeed in overcoming his history to practice law once again, or will his past continue to haunt him?
response.title: عودة المحامي | LLE Badman
